# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities by email to **andrei.lungeanu@gmail.com**.

Include a description of the issue, steps to reproduce it, and the affected versions if known. You can expect an initial response within a few days. Please do not open a public GitHub issue for anything you suspect might be a security vulnerability.

## Scope

This package wraps the Smartbill.ro REST API. Vulnerabilities in Smartbill itself should be reported to Smartbill support directly.
